question: Mysuru Dasara Festival is a ______-day festival celebrated in Karnataka.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__**

 

__
 
• **Mysuru Dasara Festival is a 10-day festival celebrated in Karnataka.**
 
• It is one of the most important and **grand festivals of Karnataka.**
 
• The festival is celebrated to mark the** victory of good over evil and is dedicated to Goddess Chamundeshwari,** who is worshipped during the festival.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great pomp and show and includes various cultural events, music, dance, and a grand procession of beautifully decorated elephants.
 
• The festival attracts a large number of tourists from all over the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Option 1) 5:** This option is incorrect as Mysuru Dasara Festival is not a 5-day festival.
 
• ** Option 2) 12:** This option is incorrect as Mysuru Dasara Festival is not a 12-day festival.
 
• ** Option 3) 7: **This option is incorrect as Mysuru Dasara Festival is not a 7-day festival.
